Found 66 items in registries @afterglow:

Showing items 1-66 of 66:

- theme (registry:theme) - The tokens, typography, motion and CRT effects used by every component. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- accordion (registry:ui) - Sections that open one at a time or many. The marker is a plus that rotates into a minus. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- alert (registry:ui) - A notice with a lit left edge and a matching icon. Four tones. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- alert-dialog (registry:ui) - A pink confirmation dialog for destructive or irreversible actions. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- avatar (registry:ui) - Initials in mono inside a bordered square. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- badge (registry:ui) - A bordered rectangle of tracked-out mono for a status or a count. Eight variants. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- breadcrumb (registry:ui) - A path in mono, separated by slashes, with the current segment in white. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- button (registry:ui) - Seven variants and five sizes in uppercase mono. `primary` is filled phosphor; `signal` marks urgent states. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- calendar (registry:ui) - A square month grid with phosphor selection, an amber today marker and Afterglow navigation buttons. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- card (registry:ui) - A panel with a colored left edge, or `accent={false}` for none. With a `CardLink`, the edge traces the card on hover. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- chart (registry:ui) - Recharts wired to the five chart colors, terminal tooltip and stepped reveal. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- checkbox (registry:ui) - `[ ]` and `[x]`. A square that fills with the beam when it is on. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- code-block (registry:ui) - Shiki wired to the phosphor palette, with a copy button. Takes a string of code and highlights it on the server. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- collapsible (registry:ui) - The accordion without the styling, for when you have drawn the trigger yourself. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- combobox (registry:ui) - A text field that filters its list as you type. With `multiple` set, each pick becomes a chip in the field. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- command (registry:ui) - A search line and a list that narrows as you type. Groups, shortcuts, and a dialog wrapper. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- context-menu (registry:ui) - A system menu at the pointer, with choices, submenus, shortcut hints and destructive actions. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- dialog (registry:ui) - Opens in four steps rather than on a curve, with one pass of the beam down the panel. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- dropdown-menu (registry:ui) - Items, checkbox and radio items, submenus, and shortcut hints in the same mono as the keys. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- empty (registry:ui) - A dashed hairline box for a list with nothing in it. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- hover-card (registry:ui) - A bordered preview panel for a link, with one phosphor edge and room for interactive content. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- input (registry:ui) - A hairline field in mono with a phosphor caret. Focus brightens the border instead of adding a ring. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- input-group (registry:ui) - Icons, text and buttons inside a field's border. The whole group glows while the control in it has focus. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- input-otp (registry:ui) - One cell per character, with a drawn caret in the active one. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- kbd (registry:ui) - A key with two pixels of implied depth under it. Pass `glyph` for `⌘`, `⇧` and `↵`. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- label (registry:ui) - A field's name, set as an eyebrow. Small, tracked out, phosphor. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- pagination (registry:ui) - Page numbers as joined cells, so a run of them reads as one control. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- popover (registry:ui) - A bordered panel anchored to its trigger. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- progress (registry:ui) - Three pixels of track and a light in it. Pass `indeterminate` for a segment that sweeps and leaves. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- radio-group (registry:ui) - Terminal-style radio marks in their unchecked and checked states: `( )` and `(•)`. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- resizable (registry:ui) - Panels split by a hairline that lights when you take hold of it. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- scroll-area (registry:ui) - A hairline track and a square thumb, in place of the operating system's own. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- select (registry:ui) - A trigger that reads as a field, and a list whose chosen row carries a lit left edge. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- separator (registry:ui) - One pixel of the border color, horizontal or vertical. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- sheet (registry:ui) - A drawer from any of the four edges. The edge it slides from keeps a lit border. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- skeleton (registry:ui) - Placeholder rows in dim phosphor. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- slider (registry:ui) - A hairline track, a lit range, and a square handle. Single value or range. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- spinner (registry:ui) - A lit pixel travelling a 3x3 grid, four brightness levels trailing behind it. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- switch (registry:ui) - A squared-off rocker in two sizes. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- table (registry:ui) - A manifest in mono with hairline rules. `is-numeric` gives a cell amber tabular figures. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- tabs (registry:ui) - Two variants: joined segments and a quieter line. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- textarea (registry:ui) - A multiline field that grows with its content. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- toast (registry:ui) - Sonner alerts that blink into place with a border, tint and icon for each tone. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- toggle (registry:ui) - A button that stays down. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- toggle-group (registry:ui) - Toggles joined the way the segmented tabs are. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- tooltip (registry:ui) - A compact label with one lit edge and no arrow. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- alarm-button (registry:component) - Two flashes and a rest, the way a warning lamp blinks. Pointing at it stops the flashing. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- boot-log (registry:component) - A self test that prints itself line by line, at its final height from the first frame. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- caret (registry:component) - A blinking block that follows the surrounding font size. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- connector (registry:component) - A rule extending left or right from a heading. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- eyebrow (registry:component) - The tracked-out line above a heading, with an optional block caret. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- led (registry:component) - A status lamp and the line it sits in. Four tones, and the idle one holds still. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- prompt (registry:component) - A shell line. Sigil, field and caret share one row with no border between them. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- scanlines (registry:component) - The glass. Two densities, a multiply blend, and a fixed mode for putting a whole page behind one sheet. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- screen (registry:component) - A framed CRT surface. Scanlines by default, with the aperture grille, bloom, roll bar and grain opt in. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- shell (registry:component) - A command transcript and prompt with command history. Bring the commands and their effects. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- terminal-window (registry:component) - Window chrome in three conventions: macOS, Windows, or a slim hairline version. Resizable and collapsible. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- date-picker (registry:block) - A calendar, popover and button composed into an installable single-date picker. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- operator-dashboard (registry:block) - A full-page operations dashboard with boot status, volume health, rebuild progress and a shell. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- terminal (registry:style) - The shared theme and every registry component in one `shadcn init` preset. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-copied (registry:hook) - Writes a string to the clipboard and holds a `copied` flag for two seconds, so a control can confirm the copy. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-reduced-motion (registry:hook) - Reads the reduced-motion query and re-reads it when the setting changes, for the effects CSS cannot switch off. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- typewriter (registry:component) - A line that types itself one character at a time, at its finished width from the first frame. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- scramble (registry:component) - Text resolving out of glyph soup, left to right. On mount, on hover, or when it scrolls into view. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- grain (registry:component) - Tube noise over anything. A static filter by default, or a capped canvas loop that pauses off screen. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- glitch (registry:component) - Channel separation over a subtree. Two colour-shifted copies clipped into bands that jump on steps. [@afterglow] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`
